boundaryRule: The original combined NRS Culross and Valleyfield locality is preserved for provenance. Every public Culross planner point was tested against a compact OSM-informed Royal Burgh visitor boundary, with only a narrow walking extension to West Kirk, and against the retained Culross parish boundary.

attractions.name: Culross harbour, community pier and West Green

excluded.name: High Valleyfield and Low Valleyfield
excluded.reason: Part of the combined NRS statistical locality but not part of the Culross visitor town.

excluded.name: Dunimarle, Valleyfield Woods, Preston Island and Devilla Forest
excluded.reason: Wider-area destinations outside the active Culross visitor boundary.

excluded.name: Unverified private or customer parking
excluded.reason: The planner publishes only the two official public Culross car parks.

excluded.name: Palace-site toilets and generic picnic-table pins
excluded.reason: The practical planner uses the dependable council toilets and groups Low Causeway tables into one named picnic area.

excluded.name: Occasional community bakery, brunch and market food
excluded.reason: Useful events, but not dependable enough for the core ranked Eat list.
